<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="1563" dy="-215" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam rectangle {
 BackgroundColor #F0F4FF
 BorderColor #3A6BD4
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
 RoundCorner 12
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #3A6BD4
 FontSize 10
}
skinparam defaultFontName DM Sans

title AI-Driven Smart LMS — Technology Stack

' ── Layer 1: Frontend ─────────────────────────────
rectangle \"**Presentation Layer (Frontend)**\" #EEF4FF {
 rectangle \"React.js 18.x\n(Single Page App)\" as React #D6E4FF
 rectangle \"Vite 5.x\n(Build Tool)\" as Vite #D6E4FF
 rectangle \"Tailwind CSS 3.x\n(Neumorphic UI)\" as Tailwind #D6E4FF
}

' ── Layer 2: Backend ──────────────────────────────
rectangle \"**Business Logic Layer (Backend)**\" #EFFFEF {
 rectangle \"FastAPI 0.104+\n(REST API)\" as FastAPI #C8F0DC
 rectangle \"Python 3.10+\n(Language)\" as Python #C8F0DC
 rectangle \"Uvicorn\n(ASGI Server)\" as Uvicorn #C8F0DC
 rectangle \"SQLAlchemy 2.x\n(ORM)\" as SQLAlchemy #C8F0DC
}

' ── Layer 3: AI Layer ─────────────────────────────
rectangle \"**AI Layer**\" #F5EEFF {
 rectangle \"Dlib 19.24\n(Face Recognition)\" as Dlib #EDE0FF
 rectangle \"Gemini API\n(gemini-2.5-flash)\" as Gemini #EDE0FF
 rectangle \"FAISS 1.7+\n(Vector Search)\" as FAISS #EDE0FF
 rectangle \"Sentence-Transformers\n(Text Embeddings)\" as ST #EDE0FF
 rectangle \"difflib + ST\n(Plagiarism)\" as Plag #EDE0FF
}

' ── Layer 4: Auth ─────────────────────────────────
rectangle \"**Security Layer**\" #FFF3EE {
 rectangle \"JWT / python-jose\n(Auth Tokens)\" as JWT #FFE0D0
 rectangle \"bcrypt / passlib\n(Password Hashing)\" as Bcrypt #FFE0D0
}

' ── Layer 5: Database ─────────────────────────────
rectangle \"**Data Layer**\" #FFFDE7 {
 rectangle \"MySQL 8.x\n(Relational Database)\" as MySQL #FFF9C4
}

' ── Flow Arrows ───────────────────────────────────
React -down-> FastAPI : HTTP / REST API
FastAPI -down-> SQLAlchemy : ORM Queries
FastAPI -down-> Dlib : Face Recognition
FastAPI -down-> Gemini : AI Responses
FastAPI -down-> FAISS : Vector Search
FastAPI -right-> JWT : Auth Middleware
SQLAlchemy -down-> MySQL : SQL Queries

@enduml
